events.title: There's no AI in Submind!
events.summary: With more and more people showing up on our socials in order to know the game better, it was a matter of time until somebody asked: "Did you use AI in this game?" The short answer is: No, there's not any kind of AI in Submind. But we feel the need to give a long answer as well. So far, this Steam Next Fest has been amazing for us, Recently, we got over 300 wishlists and it keeps going up every day! We're very grateful for your support!And, don't forget that you can follow our socials to stay in touch with our current and future plans. We have some people on our Discord now as well! Don't forget that you can follow our socials to stay in touch with our current and future plans (Links at the bottom of this announcement)

events.title: Gameplay Trailer released + Demo on October 8th!
events.summary: Greetings, operators! With Steam Next Fest rapidly approaching (less than a month now!), we wanted to give you the chance to test our game ahead of the event! Starting October 8th, the demo will be available for everyone to play all the way until the end of Next Fest on October 26th! And if you do give it a try, everyone on the team would absolutely love to hear what you think. The good, the bad, and everything in between. events.title: Submind - Official Announcement
events.summary: Dear Operators!It’s finally happening.What we have been working on for the past 8 months is finally becoming a reality. We can proudly announce our PC game Submind, which will be presented at Steam Next Fest.Submind is not your usual clichéd co-op horror game. It’s a horror game without jumpscares (the Game Director doesn’t like them). We were inspired by the visual style of Tim Burton and tried to bring some of that feeling into our game.
